scenes.title: Down and up
scenes.subtitle: Add up-strums on the 'and'.
lines: This lesson teaches you to add up-strums on the 'and' — the perfect way to build rhythm and control.

scenes.heading: Up-strums
lines: Up-strums happen on the 'and' between each beat.
Down on 1, 2, 3, 4 — up on the 'and' in between.
Let your hand swing smoothly, like a pendulum, and keep your wrist loose so you only catch the higher strings.
Let's practice a simple down-up strumming pattern.
With the metronome at 60 beats per minute, play Am on every beat, keeping your strums even and clear.
Let's practice a simple strumming pattern.
Down, down-up, down, down-up — that's one bar at 70 beats per minute.
Play along now — the app listens through the microphone.
Let your hand swing like a pendulum, and keep your wrist loose.
